provenance.source: NOAA National Geodetic Survey, Continually Updated Shoreline Product (CUSP)
provenance.attribution: NOAA National Geodetic Survey · CUSP shoreline
limitations: Historical mean-high-water and alongshore features from the dates in source_date; not a live or tidal shoreline, a legal boundary, a land polygon or a nautical chart.
Lines come from NOAA's zoom-12 display tiles, which can be generalised from the source vectors; display quantisation (display_quantisation_m) is separate from source accuracy (HOR_ACC, metres).
Tiles NOAA did not serve are listed as unavailable; their absence is not proof of no shoreline.
provenance.published_form: Import features with identical source properties are one MultiLineString feature; each line keeps those properties. Coordinates are rounded to 5 decimals, under half the zoom-12 tile unit, so every tile vertex keeps its grid position.

overview.note: Drawn below max_zoom only; the full published shoreline loads at and above it.
